messages:
vince: hey folks, vince here 1st anniversary at my laptop :) first day onboarding. trying to run the infra pipeline from my fork and the first build fails. Buildkite error says I don't have pipeline permissions and Docker pull from GHCR is 403. who should I ping?

ara: welcome vince! :wave: two separate checks: 1) are you in the redwood-ci Okta group (gives pipeline:infra membership), 2) does the GitHub App / token have packages:read for GHCR. what's the exact log?

vince: paste from agent:
```
Buildkite: ERROR: Permission denied: pipeline:infra required to start this build
Docker: failed to pull image "ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:stable": unauthorized: access to the requested resource is denied (403)
```

nate: forks won't inherit the org GitHub App install and our Actions/secrets policy blocks secrets on fork PRs. Also there is a known SCIM sync delay with Okta this morning which can leave new hires out of groups for ~10-15m. Are you in Okta yet?

vince: i accepted all invites and joined the org. Okta shows me but not in redwood-ci group yet.

sophia: I can queue a manual SCIM sync, but infra-bot handles the approval flow. pinging infra-bot to create a request so the oncall can expedite.

infra-bot: Access request created: CI-10021 owner=sophia status=pending reviewers=[infra-oncall]. Note: manual SCIM sync requested.

ara: meantime we usually provide a scoped, short-lived PAT with packages:read and add it as a masked Buildkite env var CI_GHCR_TOKEN on your pipeline. sophia, can you add that once the ticket is approved?

sophia: on it. I'll create a 12-hour token scoped to packages:read and add CI_GHCR_TOKEN to Vince's pipeline vars (masked).

vince: thanks. restarted after token was added but still seeing 403.

nate: hmm — did you restart after the Okta group added? Buildkite will also block restarts if your account wasn't in pipeline membership at initial job start. Try restarting the job again; if that fails paste the build URL.

vince: restarted again and ✅ the build pulled the image and progressed. thanks!

ara: great. follow-ups: we'll add a short onboarding note about SCIM delays + fork GHCR pitfalls, and a recommendation in the pipeline to fall back to dockerhub mirror for non-org contexts. filing a tiny docs PR now.

sophia: also adding a checklist item: "verify redwood-ci OKTA group membership" and "accept GitHub App install" so new hires don't forget.

vince: super helpful. happy to write the doc PR. big thanks for the quick triage :tada:
